description: This Python source file implements URL normalization for database connection strings, specifically targeting PostgreSQL URLs to adapt them for use with SQLAlchemy and asyncpg. It defines a data class for normalized configuration, helper functions to normalize URL schemes, and a main function to process the URL, remove conflicting SSL parameters, and produce the appropriate connection configuration.

classes.name: NormalizedDatabaseConfig
classes.description: A data class representing the normalized database URL and connection arguments for SQLAlchemy asyncpg connections.

methods.name: str _normalize_scheme_to_asyncpg(url: str)
methods.description: Converts various PostgreSQL URL schemes to the standard 'postgresql+asyncpg' scheme.

methods.name: Optional[str] _pop_query_param( query_params: MutableMapping[str, str], key: str )
methods.description: Removes and returns a query parameter from a URL query parameters mapping, case-insensitively.

methods.name: NormalizedDatabaseConfig normalize_asyncpg_database_url(raw_url: str)
methods.description: Main function to normalize a PostgreSQL database URL by adjusting the scheme, removing incompatible query params, and mapping SSL mode to connection arguments.
